title: Signal Harvest: quant onboarding notes and weekly standup
content:
Week of 2026-08-10 — quick log + decisions + next steps.

Attendees (ad-hoc throughout the week): Maya, Ravi, Sofia, Ethan, Priya, Alex (infra), Ben (sre sync).

TL;DR:
- Primary focus: finish initial 4-bit PTQ onboarding for atlas-small-v2 and run two eval stratas (safety + instruction-following) across PRQ/Per-channel profiles.
- Early evals show a small but consistent regression on commonsense QA (EM drop ~1.8 pts) for the most aggressive per-layer PTQ config. Need targeted prompt/eval probes to pinpoint where token-level fidelity collapses.
- KV-cache prefetched entries causing slightly higher GPU memory spike in micro-batch mode; Ethan found a double-counting bug in the cache accounting layer (PR linked above).
- Decision: hold canary rollout for atlas-small-v2-4bit-perlayer until further targeted evals and a fallback policy is added in routing layer (JIRA MLON-1984).

Meeting notes / standup captures: 
- Mon 08/10 10:00 — Onboarding sync (Maya, Ravi, Sofia)
  - Outline for onboarding checklist reviewed: model linters, tokenizer sanity, example prompts, eval-suite and perf harness.
  - Action: Ravi to add tokenizer edge-case tests (emoji, long-URL split); due Tue 08/11.
  - Action: Sofia to run a small adversarial prompt set (10K tokens) to check decoding divergence between 16-bit baseline and 4-bit PTQ.

- Tue 08/11 14:30 — Eval triage (Sofia, Priya, Ethan)
  - Ran safety eval (SNR-safety-v2) and instruction-following benchmark (IF-commonsense-lite).
  - Observations: 4-bit per-layer config yields: safety-pass rate unchanged (~98%), but IF-commonsense-lite EM 1.8 pts lower than baseline. Per-channel 4-bit (slower quant) is within 0.3 pts of baseline.
  - Hypothesis: quantization noise is being amplified in logits for longer contexts where KV-cache re-use occurs — need focused probe.
  - Action: Priya to craft a short eval that toggles cache hits vs cache misses for same prompts. Add to nightly evals.

- Wed 08/12 09:15 — Infra / perf quick sync (Ethan, Alex, Ben)
  - Ethan: found bug in cache accounting that double-counts Prefetch slots when micro-batching + async prefetch enabled. Related to recent microbatch refactor.
  - Perf impact: on p4d across atlas-small-v2, observed 5–8% higher peak mem under synthetic microbatch workflow (batch size 4, token length distribution 16/128/512).
  - Mitigation: revert the accounting change in staging and re-run heavy microbatch smoke tests. PR created (GH-672).

- Thu 08/13 11:00 — Eval results review (full team)
  - Ran focused probe with cache-hot vs cache-cold variants (Priya's test). Result: per-layer 4-bit shows larger drop in cache-hot path than cache-cold path (EM drop mostly in repeated-context QA examples).
  - Interpretation: errors look like repetition/attention drift on re-used KV entries. Could be quant-accumulated rounding across attention states.
  - Decision: label per-layer 4-bit as "requires KV-aware validation"; add gating check in onboarding checklist.

Experiments run this week (short log):
- 4-bit PTQ profiles: 
  - profile-a (per-layer aggressive) — epochs=1, per-tensor scf, clip=0.02
  - profile-b (per-channel conservative) — epochs=3, per-channel scaling, clip=0.01
- Eval harness: IF-commonsense-lite (5k queries), SNR-safety-v2 (3k), and the new cache-hot/cold set (1k pairs).
- Perf runs: microbatch (b4), continuous-batch (b16 simulated), latency p99 logged for topk=1.

High level numeric summary (median of 3 runs each):
- Baseline fp16 atlas-small-v2: IF EM = 74.5, safety pass = 98.1%, p99 latency (b4) = 220ms, GPU mem = 8.9GB.
- profile-a (4bit per-layer): IF EM = 72.7, safety pass = 97.9%, p99 latency (b4) = 190ms, GPU mem = 6.4GB.
- profile-b (4bit per-channel): IF EM = 74.2, safety pass = 98.0%, p99 latency (b4) = 195ms, GPU mem = 6.6GB.
Notes: numbers are noisy; we need a larger sweep (10 seeds) before finalizing thresholds.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Is the per-layer failure pattern correlated with specific attention heads or with distribution shift in LN parameters after PTQ? (Need head-level probes).
- Are repeated-context failures recoverable with small temperature tweaks or do they require structural correction (e.g., KV rescaling)?
- How does the optimized kernel path interact with quantized weights when sequence length > 512? (We observed slight decoding time jitter at 1024 after using the fused attention kernel).

Action items (owners + tickets):
- Ravi: add tokenizer edge-case tests + link to onboarding checklist (JIRA:MLON-1991) — due 2026-08-14.
- Sofia: run head-level logits diffs for top 6 attention heads across per-layer vs per-channel (GH-PR: add results to GH-699) — due 2026-08-16.
- Priya: add cache-hot/cold test to nightly evals, include both instruction and safety subsets (JIRA:MLON-1984 follow-up) — due 2026-08-15.
- Ethan: revert microbatch accounting change in staging, re-run perf smoke (GH-672) — in progress.
- Maya: add gating check to the onboarding checklist: "KV-aware quant validation + cache-hot acceptance" and update Confluence page.

Notes to future self (random capture):
- When writing the gating check, include a small script that can synthesize repeated-context pairs so that teams on Dedicated/Private can run quickly before rollout.
- Document the acceptable EM degradation threshold per-customer tier: non-critical (<=2.0 pts), business-critical (<=0.5 pts). Put this in rollout policy doc.

Quick debugging log (raw snippets):
- Sofia: "noticed logit skew around token 12–16 on repeated question blocks; pattern consistent across seeds"
- Ethan: "cache accounting double-counts prefetch when async prefetch enabled + microbatch>1; reproduced on staging p4d"

Follow-ups for next week:
- finish 10-seed sweep for profile-a and profile-b across IF-commonsense-full (10k) and the cache probe.
- build small kernel-level test to check fused-attention behavior with quantized weights at seq_len=1024. Reach out to infra for a reserved node slot for 2h.
- start drafting a short canary run plan that includes automatic fallback routing to per-channel profile if per-layer fails checks during canary.

Meta notes: 
- This doc is intentionally rough — captures the running threads that need consolidation into a single new onboarding playbook page once we stabilize profiles.
- If you are iterating on quant profiles, please add a 1–2 line summary to the GH PR describing the expected trade-offs for perf vs fidelity (e.g., "profile-a: -30% mem, -1.8 EM on IF-small; profile-b: -25% mem, -0.3 EM").

End of week quick retrospective (what went well / stuck):
- Went well: rapid end-to-end evals; infra caught a perf regression early. Good cross-team signal.
- Stuck: we still don't have a clean, reproducible head-level probe; need better instrumentation in the distill logs.

If you want to pick something up to unblock: look at GH-699 (head-level diffs) or GH-672 (cache accounting) depending on whether you prefer model or infra work.

-- Maya (notes captured 2026-08-14)
